allow: PowerShell($r="$env:APPDATA\\Claude"; $l="$env:LOCALAPPDATA\\Claude"; foreach\($d in @\($r,$l\)\){ if\(Test-Path $d\){ "=== $d ==="; Get-ChildItem $d -Force | Select-Object Mode,LastWriteTime,Length,Name | Format-Table -AutoSize } else { "MISSING: $d" } })

PowerShell(Get-ChildItem "$env:APPDATA","$env:LOCALAPPDATA" -Directory -Force | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'claude|anthropic' } | Select-Object FullName,LastWriteTime | Format-Table -AutoSize; "--- .claude root ---"; Get-ChildItem "$env:USERPROFILE\\.claude" -Force | Select-Object LastWriteTime,Length,Name | Format-Table -AutoSize)
